title: Name, nickname and first instruments
summary: Interviewer confirms the pronunciation and spelling of Bourgeau and the nickname Fan. He says he began playing before 1929, first plectum banjo, then piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Let me give your names to bourgeois. How do you pronounce your name?
And I might give the spelling here too because-
Because I've known people that had the same name spelled a little bit different too. Like O-I-S something on the end. And your real name is Joseph but they call you Fan.
They call me Fan for short, nickname.
You said because you looked like you were Chinese?

I looked like a Chinaman, that's why they call me that. And we started, I started around 29. No, I started before 29 playing with different little bands. And I first started playing with a plectum banjo. Was that five strings? Five strings, plectum banjo. Then I left it go and I began to play piano a little.
Can you tell me just where you were born? Is it here in the city?
